title: Ueno Digital Bank Crisis Leaves 3 Million Customers Locked Out
tags: News|customers locked out|digital bank|Paraguay|paraguay president|ueno digital bank
body: Paraguay has been thrown into political and financial turmoil after President Santiago Peña announced his resignation following the collapse of Ueno Digital Bank, a major digital lender that left nearly three million customers unable to access their accounts. The banking crisis has triggered public protests, criminal investigations, and renewed debate about the risks of keeping money within traditional financial institutions. Peña announced his departure on November 5, shortly before lawmakers advanced impeachment proceedings against him. The lower house subsequently approved the impeachment motion unanimously, sending the case to the Senate. The collapse has become one of Paraguay’s most significant financial scandals, raising questions about regulatory oversight, political connections, and the protection of ordinary depositors. Ueno Digital Bank Collapse Triggers Political Crisis in Paraguay Ueno Bank grew rapidly from a relatively obscure financial company into one of Paraguay’s most prominent digital lenders. By June 2026, the institution reportedly had approximately three million customers, representing more than 60% of the country’s adult population. However, the bank’s rapid expansion eventually attracted regulatory scrutiny. Paraguay’s central bank intervened after discovering serious financial irregularities and determining that Ueno’s capital had fallen below half the legally required minimum. The Central Bank of Paraguay will enable a platform to verify the banking entity assigned for the receipt of the advance payment of the Deposits Guarantee Fund to the savers of Ueno Bank S.A. – Banco Central del Paraguay The intervention left customers unable to access their savings through the bank’s application, payment cards, and transfer services. The situation became particularly concerning because Ueno reportedly held approximately $800 million to $850 million in public-sector deposits, including funds connected to pension and state institutions. Peña also faced questions about his previous financial relationship with Grupo Vázquez, the conglomerate linked to Ueno’s ownership. The president maintained that he had sold his stake in March 2025 and denied wrongdoing. In his resignation announcement, Peña said his priority was ensuring that affected customers could recover their money and that the country’s Deposit Guarantee Fund fulfilled its responsibilities. Banking Collapse Revives Bitcoin Self-Custody Debate The crisis has also renewed an argument frequently raised within the cryptocurrency community: financial independence and direct ownership of assets. Bitcoin supporters argue that self-custody allows individuals to hold and control their funds without depending on banks or other financial intermediaries. Unlike traditional bank deposits , Bitcoin stored in a privately controlled wallet cannot be frozen simply because a financial institution experiences insolvency. However, self-custody also introduces risks, including lost private keys, theft, and cryptocurrency price volatility. Paraguay’s banking crisis therefore highlights the importance of understanding where money is held, who controls access to it, and what protections exist when financial institutions fail. For millions of affected customers, the immediate concern remains recovering their savings as the country navigates the political consequences of Ueno Digital Bank’s collapse.

title: Nigeria tightens rules for dollar stablecoin issuers as naira coin lags
body: Nigeria’s central bank has set new rules that make issuers of dollar-linked stablecoins open a local presence and pass capital and reserve tests. Foreign companies that market their coins to Nigerians, even if they have no office in the country, will have to adapt to the new rules. Meanwhile, Nigeria’s own naira coin, cNGN, is still trying to win users. What do Nigeria’s new stablecoin rules require? The Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN) published a document called “Regulations for the Operations of Non-Security Virtual Assets in Nigeria.” It sets up licensing and oversight for what it calls Regulated Tokens. The rules were made under an order signed by President Bola Tinubu on July 17, 2026 and apply to coins that are backed by the naira and coins that are backed by foreign currencies such as the dollar. Deposit Money Tokens also fall under the rules, and so can any other token the central bank decides to add later. The President’s executive order set up a Virtual Asset Council led by the CBN while the Nigeria Revenue Service and the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) function as its vice chairs. The CBN has reportedly set a capital requirement of 15 billion naira for foreign stablecoin issuers (about $10.5 million). It also tightened rules on peer-to-peer crypto trading. Meanwhile, the SEC published its own draft rules for stablecoin issuers on August 20, 2026. Under those rules, stablecoins backed by foreign currency would need reserves of at least 120% while naira-backed and commodity-backed tokens would need 100%, and crypto-backed coins would start at 150%. Under the SEC’s draft, a digital asset firm would need between 200 million naira (about $140,600) and 2 billion naira (about $1.4 million) in capital, with the highest amount requirement aimed at exchanges and custodians. The SEC doubled the required capital in a notice in January this year. According to the draft, foreign companies must also appoint someone in Nigeria to represent it. Critics say the SEC’s requirements help big, established players and hurt small local startups. Will Nigerians choose a naira stablecoin over dollar coins? cNGN began a pilot on February 27, 2024. Cryptopolitan reported that it was pitched as an alternative to the eNaira, the government digital currency that failed to catch on. Crypto commentator Rume Ophi linked the eNaira’s weak start to a public view that it was a government tool against the crypto industry. Nigerians have long preferred dollars to the naira. During the 2024 clampdown on Binance, traders were stocking up on Tether (USDT) as the naira lost value. CBN Governor Yemi Cardoso said $26 billion moved through Binance in 2023 from sources that could not be identified. Due to the standoff, Nigerian access to the exchange was blocked and Binance executive Tigran Gambaryan was detained. Nigeria took in more than $92.1 billion in crypto between July 2024 and June 2025, a period where the standoff was still on. The CBN reportedly opened a test program for stablecoins, known as a sandbox on August 12 this year. The bank is now expected to share the details from the program and hand licenses to companies that passed. The smartest crypto minds already read our newsletter. Want in? Join them .

title: One of the Largest Short Positions In XRP History Is Building Up
body: Crypto markets rarely telegraph their next move clearly, but November 4 may have been an exception. Crypto commentator Xaif (@Xaif_Crypto) posted data showing XRP short positions on Bitfinex surged 652.89% to 468.2 million. He described it as “one of the largest short-position buildups in XRP history.” The scale of the positioning immediately raised a question that traders are now asking themselves: what happens if XRP’s price keeps moving up? A Historic Level of Short Interest Short positions are bets that an asset’s price will decline. Traders who open them profit when price falls and lose when it rises. At 468.2 million, the short interest against XRP on Bitfinex reached a level that stands out even against the full history of the asset. JUST IN: $XRP shorts on Bitfinex surge 652.89% to 468.2 MILLION. One of the largest short-position buildups in XRP history. If price moves against them, the squeeze could be explosive. pic.twitter.com/phQi7Arvye — Xaif Crypto (@Xaif_Crypto) November 5, 2026 A similar buildup of short positions happened in August but this one happened fast. The 652.89% surge concentrated around November 4, as traders rushed to bet against XRP following a sharp price move. That speed and scale of accumulation is precisely what makes the current setup significant. A large number of traders made the same bet, at roughly the same time, at roughly the same price level. The Mechanics of a Squeeze When short positions accumulate at this level, the conditions for a short squeeze take shape. If price rises rather than falls, short sellers face losses on their positions. To limit those losses, they buy XRP to close their trades. That buying pushes the price higher. Higher prices put more short sellers under pressure. More short sellers buy to cover. The move feeds itself. The size of the short position determines how severe that squeeze becomes . At 468.2 million, the potential for a sharp, self-reinforcing move to the upside is significant. XRP traded at $1.31 on November 5, up roughly 3% on the day. The shorts that opened near the bottom of the November 4 move are already in a losing position. Xaif noted that if price moves against them, “the squeeze could be explosive.” What Traders Are Watching 468.2 million in short contracts need to unwind at some point. If sellers cannot push the price lower to validate their positions, the exit becomes forced rather than voluntary. Forced exits at scale produce violent price moves. XRP has not broken decisively higher yet, but the conditions Xaif identified are in place. A short interest buildup of this size, sitting against an asset already recovering, puts significant pressure on the short side of the trade. title: China’s central bank says Solana’s Shanghai event was stopped over illegal crypto promotion
body: The People’s Bank of China (PBOC) has responded that it disrupted Solana’s mid-October event in Shanghai because of the illegal virtual currency marketing red flags raised by the event’s promoters. The PBOC official, quoted by Financial News (Jinrong Shibao), a news outlet run by the central bank, also noted that the firms and individuals behind the promotion are now under investigation. China’s central bank responds to Solana event cancellation The official cited in the Friday report said that Solana became a priority watch for the PBOC as it went around promoting its brand and buying high-profile advertising using its domestic partners. The regulator explained the double rationale behind the disruption: Solana’s SOL token is a virtual currency The Solana network supports issuing and trading tokens such as Tether’s USDT. The official explained that, based on those interpretations, marketing Solana violates Chinese law and constitutes illegal financial activity. The PBOC official also cited deficiencies in customer identification and anti-money-laundering rules in the crypto sector, as well as the speculative trading risks the asset category invites. The official noted that the central bank was not acting alone when it halted the Solana event in Shanghai, noting that it was joined by local financial regulators, public security, and market supervision authorities. PBOC tells a different story from Solana’s explanation The report by the PBOC-linked news outlet differs from the account given by Solana officials at the time of the Shanghai event’s cancellation. Shanghai was supposed to be the first stop in the four-city Accelerate China developer tour. Hangzhou, Shenzhen and Beijing were the other Chinese cities the tour planned to visit. As Cryptopolitan reported at the time, attendees received an email from the organizers on the morning of the event, October 16, informing them of a postponement over “logistical considerations at the venue.” Solana Foundation President Lily Liu intimated that the cancellation was due to turnout, writing on X, “Due to the publicity, event registrations quadrupled overnight, far exceeding the event cap.” While Liu did not mention the threat of enforcement in her post, attendees who were already at the Shangri-La hotel venue noticed law enforcement presence on-site. The central bank’s report noted that Solana came onto its radar after an aggressive campaign in which Solana branding appeared across the Shanghai skyline. The Foundation also touted its Pudong office in the world’s tallest commercially available office. This year’s cancellation was the second Solana event to be disrupted in mainland China , following a late October 2025 Solana Accelerate event in Shenzhen that was cut short by local police. Organizers cited overcrowding at the time too. The February rulebook behind the crackdown China has treated crypto business as off-limits for years. The PBOC and four other departments warned on Bitcoin risks in 2013, and a 2021 notice spelled out that Bitcoin, Ether and stablecoins like Tether hold no status as legal tender. The current rulebook dates to February 2026, when the PBOC and seven other agencies issued a notice that restated the ban and added fresh ones, including a block on unauthorized yuan-pegged stablecoins , per the official text published by the China Securities Regulatory Commission . The directive also made Chinese firms and individuals liable for knowingly assisting offshore operators that provide crypto services inside the country, even when the project runs abroad. The PBOC said it would keep targeting domestic crypto traders and the local affiliates of offshore issuance and trading platforms, working with other agencies and local governments. title: Ethereum Could Play a Bigger Role in Global Finance by 2029
body: Ethereum could become an increasingly important part of global finance over the next three years. With major investment firms already using the network for tokenized assets and developers preparing significant upgrades, Ethereum’s role could extend far beyond cryptocurrency trading. BlackRock, JPMorgan, and other financial institutions have already introduced blockchain-based investment products, while stablecoins continue finding new applications in payments and financial services. The question is no longer whether traditional finance is experimenting with Ethereum. It is how far that integration could develop by 2029. Wall Street Is Bringing Traditional Investments Onto Ethereum One of Ethereum’s biggest opportunities involves tokenization, the process of representing traditional financial assets on blockchain networks. Investment funds, government bonds, and other financial instruments can be issued or recorded digitally, potentially improving settlement efficiency and making transfers easier to manage. BlackRock’s BUIDL fund, originally launched on Ethereum, is an important example. JPMorgan has also introduced a tokenized money market fund using Ethereum infrastructure. As Bitcoinist previously reported , JPMorgan’s product initially made Ethereum the only public blockchain available to its investors, although future expansion to other networks was anticipated. BlackRock CEO Larry Fink has also spoken about the potential benefits of a shared blockchain infrastructure. Speaking at the World Economic Forum in January, Fink argued that tokenization could help reduce financial transaction costs. “We need to move very rapidly to do that.” His comments referred to the broader adoption of tokenized financial assets rather than an exclusive endorsement of Ethereum. These developments suggest that traditional financial institutions are beginning to see blockchain technology as financial infrastructure rather than simply another investment opportunity. Stablecoins Could Become a Major Growth Driver Stablecoins represent another important opportunity. Ethereum supports widely used dollar-backed tokens, including USDT and USDC, allowing individuals and businesses to transfer digital dollars through blockchain-based applications. Financial institutions are also entering this market. For example, SoFi introduced its Ethereum- and Solana-based stablecoin to its banking platform , demonstrating how digital currencies are gradually becoming connected to conventional financial services. As stablecoin adoption expands, Ethereum could benefit from greater demand for payments, settlement, and decentralized financial applications. However, competition from other blockchains remains significant, particularly where transaction costs and processing speed are important. Ethereum’s Next Upgrades Could Change the Network Ethereum developers are preparing several important technical improvements. Glamsterdam, expected in late 2026, is designed to improve block production and transaction processing. Hegotá, planned for 2027, will focus on transaction inclusion and additional account functionality. The longer-term roadmap is even more ambitious. According to the Ethereum Foundation’s September protocol update , developers are targeting quantum-resistant protection across Ethereum’s execution, consensus, and data layers by December 2029. The Foundation described its long-term security commitment as follows: “Shipping post-quantum readiness early is the secure thing to do.” This is an important development because financial institutions require secure, dependable infrastructure before committing more assets to blockchain-based systems. Still, major upgrades require extensive testing. As Bitcoinist recently covered , developers corrected a potentially serious Glamsterdam vulnerability before its mainnet deployment. Could Ethereum Become Part of Everyday Finance? By 2029, Ethereum could support a wider range of financial services, from tokenized investment products to stablecoin settlements and automated transactions. We believe the most important developments to watch will be institutional adoption, stablecoin activity, and whether Ethereum successfully delivers its planned upgrades. None of these outcomes is guaranteed, and increasing network usage does not automatically mean ETH prices will rise and go up. Nevertheless, the growing involvement of major financial institutions suggests Ethereum has an opportunity to become a more established part of global finance. Could Ethereum eventually become one of the main networks connecting traditional banking with blockchain technology? What do you think?

title: Bitcoin Holds Critical $76K Level as AI Sell-Off Triggers Market-Wide Panic
tags: Bitcoin|News|Bitcoin analysis|bitcoin holds critical level|bitcoin level|bitcoin price|bitcoin sell off|btc price|market wide panic
body: Bitcoin holds critical level as it showed early signs of stabilization on Friday after a sharp market-wide sell-off pushed the cryptocurrency toward $75,000. However, the recovery remains fragile, with investors still cautious following heavy losses across technology stocks, more than $1 billion in crypto liquidations, and continued withdrawals from US spot Bitcoin ETFs. The world’s largest cryptocurrency briefly recovered toward $76,150 after touching approximately $75,200 late Thursday, suggesting that buyers were beginning to step in following the latest decline. Ethereum also recorded a modest recovery, gaining around 0.3%, while the broader 80 Index advanced 0.2%. Despite these small gains, the broader market remains under pressure. Bitcoin is still down around 5.3% over the previous 24 hours, while Ethereum has lost approximately 7.3%. The latest rebound comes after an exceptionally difficult trading session on Wall Street, where technology stocks experienced substantial selling pressure as investors reconsidered the outlook for artificial intelligence infrastructure spending. AI-Driven Sell-Off Triggers More Than $1 Billion in Crypto Liquidations Thursday’s stock market decline quickly spread into the cryptocurrency sector, highlighting the continued relationship between digital assets and traditional risk markets. The Nasdaq Composite dropped 5.5% as investors reacted to concerns that the newly elected Democratic majority in Congress could introduce additional obstacles for the expansion of AI data centers. The uncertainty surrounding future infrastructure spending has created pressure on companies that benefited significantly from the artificial intelligence investment boom. A stunning $2.5 trillion was wiped off the value of the tech-heavy Nasdaq on Thursday as investors rushed to dump tech stocks, rattled by fears that Democrats’ midterm victories could slow the AI buildout. But another force made the sell-off more brutal: Investors who had borrowed heavily to bet on the boom were under pressure to sell. – CNN on X Approximately $1.1 billion of those liquidations involved long positions, meaning traders betting on higher cryptocurrency prices were responsible for most of the losses. This suggests that the market experienced a substantial leverage reset as falling prices forced traders to close positions or triggered automatic liquidations. Bitcoin’s derivatives market also showed signs of changing sentiment. Open interest increased from $21.8 billion to approximately $22.1 billion, indicating that traders were returning to the market despite the recent volatility as bitcoin holds critical level. However, the increase does not necessarily signal renewed bullish confidence. Much of the activity appears to reflect traders rebuilding positions after the liquidation event. Bitcoin ETF Outflows Add to Selling Pressure Institutional demand also remains an important concern as Bitcoin attempts to establish a stronger recovery. US spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded additional outflows on Thursday, reversing some of the optimism that followed the midterm elections. Fidelity’s Wise Origin Bitcoin Fund (FBTC) experienced approximately $200 million in withdrawals, while BlackRock’s iShares Bitcoin Trust (IBIT) recorded another $105 million in outflows. The withdrawals extended IBIT’s consecutive outflow streak to five trading sessions, highlighting the cautious approach institutional investors are currently taking toward Bitcoin exposure. Traders Turn Their Attention to the Latest US Jobs Report Beyond developments in the stock and cryptocurrency markets, investors are also preparing for another important economic event. The US employment report is scheduled for release at 8:30 a.m. Eastern Time on Friday, with economists surveyed by FactSet expecting the economy to have added approximately 65,000 jobs during October. The figures could influence expectations surrounding the Federal Reserve’s next monetary policy decisions. A weaker-than-expected employment report could strengthen expectations for a more cautious approach to interest rates, potentially improving sentiment toward risk assets. On the other hand, stronger employment figures could complicate expectations for monetary easing and create additional uncertainty for investors. With Bitcoin already struggling to maintain its recent gains, the employment data could become another important catalyst for short-term market direction. Privacy Coins Show Greater Resilience as Altcoin Sentiment Weakens Not every cryptocurrency experienced the same level of selling pressure during Thursday’s market decline. Privacy-focused assets demonstrated relatively stronger performance, with Monero (XMR) falling approximately 3.2% over 24 hours compared with Bitcoin’s 5.3% decline. Zcash (ZEC) also attracted attention after activating its NU7 upgrade early Friday. The update reduced the target time between blocks from 75 seconds to 25 seconds, while the token gained approximately 1% since midnight UTC. Other projects experienced considerably more difficult trading conditions. Hyperliquid (HYPE) has fallen approximately 19% from its $96 peak reached the previous week. The token had rallied following news of a deal involving Intercontinental Exchange (ICE) and Trade[XYZ) to introduce Hyperliquid-based perpetual futures to US retail traders. However, some of that optimism has since faded. Injective (INJ), meanwhile, has performed relatively well, gaining approximately 14% over the week after Nasdaq approved the listing of Canary Capital’s staked INJ ETF, according to an SEC filing. Despite these individual gains, the broader altcoin market continues to show signs of weakening speculative interest. CoinMarketCap’s Altcoin Season Index dropped to 44 out of 100, its lowest reading since September. Bitcoin Faces Key Liquidity Levels Around $75K and $77K Looking at the technical picture, Bitcoin is approaching an important area that could determine whether the latest recovery develops into a stronger rebound or becomes another temporary bounce. On the upside, the $76,800–$77,000 range represents an important level to watch. A convincing move above this zone could help Bitcoin regain some of its lost momentum and improve short-term market sentiment. For bulls, the immediate objective is to defend the $75,000 area and establish a stronger position above $76,000. Failure to maintain this support could expose Bitcoin to another move toward the $74,000 liquidity zone. On the other hand, reclaiming $77,000 would represent an encouraging development, although a sustained recovery would require stronger buying interest and improved institutional demand. For now, BTC’s technical outlook remains cautious as Bitcoin holds critical level. The combination of ETF outflows, elevated derivatives volatility, and uncertainty surrounding the broader financial markets suggests that the next few trading sessions could be particularly important. What do you think happens next? Can Bitcoin regain $77,000 and turn the latest recovery into a stronger rebound, or will continued ETF outflows and uncertainty across traditional markets push BTC toward $74,000?

title: Cryptopolitan Report: A Pill To Help Dogs Live Longer Is Near. Half Our Readers Are Ready To Sign Up
body: The first ever approved drug intended to extend lifespan is probably not going to be for people but rather for senior dogs. The reality of this becoming available is way closer than most people realise. We asked our newsletter readers in one of our longevity editions on whether they’d give it to their own dog after the FDA approves. Half of the respondents said yes without waiting, which is interesting given what an approval would and wouldn’t actually prove. Longevity Has Become A Serious Business A couple of years ago, the word “longevity” was almost always associated with wellness content creators, cold plunges and supplements with varying degrees of credibility. For the most part, that kind of association has not drastically changed. What has changed, however, is the money behind it. Longevity biotech saw a record $18.4 billion in investments come in last year in 2025, which was up by $4.7 billion the previous year. According to a report published by Longevity.Technology , by mid-September of this year, another $12.1 billion has already come in. There are more than 1,000 drug programmes already in human trials so the pipeline is expanding along with the funding. The size of some of the investments coming into some of these companies are also enormous. Retro Biosciences, a Sam Altman-backed company, which has a goal of adding ten healthy years to human life, reached a $1.8 billion valuation in May, while NewLimit raised $435 million in June. There is , however, a big regulatory hurdle hanging over the human longevity space. Natural aging is not considered as a disease and this means companies cannot seek approval for a drug that targets aging itself. Instead, they must show effectiveness against specific conditions like Alzheimer’s, muscle loss or heart disease. A pill that is designed to extend lifespan alone has no straightforward path to regulatory approval. The situation here is very different for dogs. Why The First Lifespan Drug Might Be For Dogs Loyal is the company leading the effort to help dogs live longer. They are a San Francisco based start up that has raised more than $150 million for this cause. LOY-002 is the company’s most advanced drug, which is a daily beef-flavoured pill for dogs aged 10 and above weighing at least 14 pounds. The treatment is said to target metabolic shifts that accompany aging, aiming to delay disease rather than a single illness. Unlike a lot of the human longevity companies, Loyal has a regulatory approval path that could get its drug on the shelves a lot sooner. The FDA’s Center for Veterinary Medicine offers an expanded conditional approval route that allows animal drugs to reach the market before long term trials are finished. This is provided it clears effectiveness, safety and manufacturing. LOY-002 has already cleared two of the three technical sections. In February 2025, the FDA accepted its reasonable expectation of effectiveness submission and then its safety package in January of this year. The company says that the latter safety review included data from more than 400 dogs, with many of them exhibiting typical medical conditions seen in older animals. The only thing left on the table now is manufacturing and the company expects that review in 2027. Passing the manufacturing review would mean that LOY-002 would become the very first FDA-approved drug to extend lifespan itself, in any species. CEO Celine Halioua put it simply in January: “My goal has always been to get the first drug FDA approved for lifespan extension. This safety acceptance brings us very close to achieving that vision.” The broader pet longevity market is going through a massive boom as well. Nature recently covered this growth. In the report, they stated that researchers and startups are exploring everything from gene therapies for dogs to probiotic cat food and cryopreservation. One analyst even explained to the journal that the huge investments coming into human longevity was bound to funnel into pets. The Catch Nobody Should Skip Conditional approval doesn’t establish that a drug actually extends dogs’ lives. That question is being addressed by STAY, a separate clinical trial involving 1,300 senior dogs across 70 veterinary clinics in the US. The study is expected to run for roughly four years and uses a double-blind, placebo-controlled design. It’s also the largest clinical trial ever conducted in veterinary medicine. Full approval will depend on its findings, which are still pending. An FDA-approved lifespan pill would therefore initially mean that regulators consider the treatment safe and reasonably likely to be effective. Whether it actually helps dogs live longer is a separate question that STAY is still working to answer. The same caution applies to smaller studies. Genflow Biosciences, for example, tested a gene therapy in 24 older beagles and reported improvements in biological age markers. At the six-month follow-up, however, the differences between treated dogs and the control group weren’t statistically significant. With just six dogs per group, the findings offer an encouraging direction at best, not conclusive evidence. What Our Readers Told Us Our newsletter readers are used to being early. They experiment with protocols that haven’t been tested at scale, use AI tools still in beta and invest in companies that might not turn a profit for years. That mindset is worth considering when looking at a poll about giving dogs a drug before its main clinical trial is complete. Against that backdrop, the 50% who voted “Yes, right away” isn’t particularly surprising. This is an audience accustomed to getting in early. But there’s another dimension to the decision. Unlike most technology or investment choices, this one involves an animal that cannot assess the risks or communicate its preferences. Owners also know that their pets have limited time. Once a dog reaches 10 or 11, every remaining year carries more weight. That can make waiting for additional evidence feel very different, especially when the results might arrive too late to benefit an older pet. Yes, right away (50%): The emphasis here is on “right away.” These readers are willing to consider the drug before STAY publishes its results, relying instead on the available safety data and the FDA’s assessment that it is reasonably likely to be effective. Some owners and veterinarians may consider that an acceptable trade-off for a senior dog, particularly after the safety package has been accepted. But early access is exactly what they would be getting, not proof that the treatment extends lifespan. Only after more data (~28.9%): Nearly three in ten readers want to see the clinical evidence first. This group appears more cautious about the distinction between conditional approval and a completed trial, a difference that can easily get lost in the phrase “FDA-approved.” Their position could change once STAY publishes its findings. If the trial demonstrates a meaningful lifespan benefit, some may reconsider. No (~21.1%): Roughly one in five readers rejected the idea altogether. There are several possible reasons. Some owners may not want to put a healthy dog on daily medication for years, while others may be concerned about the cost or prefer not to interfere with the natural aging process. Combined, the first two groups account for nearly 80% of respondents who are at least open to the possibility. The disagreement is less about whether canine longevity medicine has potential and more about when the available evidence is sufficient to act. For a drug that hasn’t reached the market yet, that’s a meaningful starting point. What Comes Next The next date to watch is Loyal’s manufacturing review in 2027. If that clears, vets could start prescribing LOY-002 under conditional approval, and the half of our readers who answered “right away” would get to act on it. The more important moment comes later, when STAY reports and shows whether treated dogs really do live longer. Either outcome matters well beyond pets. A positive result would give the longevity industry the thing it has never had: an approved drug, a regulatory precedent and real-world proof that slowing aging can work in a complex mammal. A weak or failed result would land on a sector that raised more than $18 billion last year largely on promise. For now, the most closely watched longevity trial in the world is happening in dog parks and vet clinics, and our readers are already lining up for it. If you're reading this, you’re already ahead. Stay there with our newsletter .

title: Bitcoin Price Goes Wild Again as US Jobs Report Smashes Expectations
body: Bitcoin is on the move again after the release of the US jobs report for October, which was well above what experts anticipated. The reading, published minutes ago, noted that the US economy added 165,000 jobs in October, while expectations were around 59,000, according to CNBC. The unemployment rate fell to 4.1%, which is below expectations of 4.2%. Moreover, data for September’s report was also revised higher by 31,000 jobs. A stronger-than-expected reading is typically bearish for risk-on assets because it shows that the US Federal Reserve can maintain tighter monetary policy without breaking the economy. As such, it’s no real surprise that BTC’s immediate price reaction was a major leg down, dumping from $76,000 to $75,200 before erasing almost all losses. The asset plunged hard yesterday after the post-election rally, going from $81,000 to a multi-month low of $75,100 before recovering slightly to $76,000. The asset’s price reaction to the jobs reports has been quite intense in the past several months. It tanked after the August reading, but jumped hard after the September report went live. Before the report was released earlier today, Nicole Bachaud, a labor economist at the job site ZipRecruiter, said that the US wouldn’t need to add many jobs to the economy in the long term, as there are simply fewer people available to work, before adding : “An aging workforce is pushing a lot of people into retirement. We have had decades of low birth rates, meaning we don’t have a lot of people who are coming in to replace those retiring workers. And immigration is now down pretty significantly, which is reducing some of that prime-age employment.” The post Bitcoin Price Goes Wild Again as US Jobs Report Smashes Expectations appeared first on CryptoPotato .
